targets.old_statement: Drivers never tailgate, high-beam, door, or horn-startle riders.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Drivers never tailgate, high-beam, door, or horn-startle riders.
targets.statement: Motorists must not follow a bicyclist too closely, should avoid high-beam headlights at night when a bicyclist approaches, must check for bicyclists approaching from behind before opening a car door, and should avoid honking and startling a bicyclist.

targets.old_statement: Riders obey all controls, slow into lanes or right edges, own full lanes for lefts, passes, hazards, and narrows, may left-ride wide one-ways, and hand-signal turns.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Riders obey all controls, slow into lanes or right edges, own full lanes for lefts, passes, hazards, and narrows, may left-ride wide one-ways, and hand-signal turns.

targets.old_statement: Rig followers never tailgate, space upgrades leftward for visibility, and dim beams at night.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Rig followers never tailgate, space upgrades leftward for visibility, and dim beams at night.
targets.statement: Motorists must not tailgate a commercial motor vehicle, must leave space when stopped behind one on an upgrade in case it drifts back when starting while staying left in the lane to remain visible, and must not use high-beam headlights when following one at night.
